points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 孙子出生于春秋时期的齐国（今山东地区），本名孙武，字长卿。他出身于军事世家，自幼受到良好的军事教育。这一时期，他系统学习了古代军事理论和战争实践，为后来创作《孙子兵法》奠定了基础。齐国的文化氛围和军事传统对孙子的思想形成产生了深远影响，使他能够接触到当时最先进的军事思想。
points.descriptionEn: Sun Tzu was born in the State of Qi (modern-day Shandong Province) during the Spring and Autumn Period. Born as Sun Wu with the courtesy name Changqing, he came from a military family background and received excellent military education from an early age. During this period, he systematically studied ancient military theories and warfare practices, laying the foundation for his later work 'The Art of War'. The cultural atmosphere and military tradition of Qi profoundly influenced the formation of Sun Tzu's thoughts, allowing him to access the most advanced military ideas of the time.

points.title: 军事生涯开始
points.description: 孙子离开齐国，前往南方吴国。在吴国，他经伍子胥推荐，得到吴王阖闾的赏识。吴王阖闾对孙子的军事才能极为重视，任命他为将军。孙子在吴国期间，参与了多次军事行动，包括著名的柏举之战，帮助吴国成为春秋时期的强国。这一时期，孙子将理论与实践相结合，形成了自己独特的军事思想体系。
points.descriptionEn: Sun Tzu left the State of Qi and traveled to the southern State of Wu. In Wu, he was recommended by Wu Zixu and gained the appreciation of King Helü. King Helü greatly valued Sun Tzu's military talent and appointed him as a general. During his time in Wu, Sun Tzu participated in numerous military campaigns, including the famous Battle of Boju, which helped Wu become a powerful state during the Spring and Autumn Period. During this period, Sun Tzu combined theory with practice, forming his unique military thought system.

points.title: 著书立说
points.description: 在吴国期间，孙子完成了其不朽著作《孙子兵法》。这部著作共十三篇，系统阐述了战争的本质、战略战术、军队组织、将领素质等军事理论。孙子通过吴宫练兵的实践，证明了自己理论的正确性。他特别强调'知己知彼，百战不殆'、'不战而屈人之兵'等战略思想，对后世军事思想产生了深远影响。《孙子兵法》不仅是一部军事著作，也是一部哲学著作，体现了孙子对战争与和平的深刻思考。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in Wu, Sun Tzu completed his immortal work 'The Art of War'. This book consists of thirteen chapters systematically elaborating on the nature of war, strategy and tactics, military organization, and the qualities of generals. Through the practice of training troops at the Wu palace, Sun Tzu proved the correctness of his theories. He particularly emphasized strategic concepts such as 'know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated' and 'subdue the enemy without fighting', which had a profound impact on later military thought. 'The Art of War' is not only a military work but also a philosophical work, reflecting Sun Tzu's deep thinking on war and peace.

points.title: 巅峰与隐退
points.description: 孙子在吴国军事生涯达到巅峰，指挥了著名的柏举之战，以三万兵力击败楚国二十万大军，攻入楚国都城郢都，创造了军事史上的奇迹。然而，随着吴王阖闾去世和夫差继位，政治环境发生变化，孙子逐渐淡出政治舞台。他选择隐退，专注于军事理论研究，完善《孙子兵法》。这一时期，孙子的军事思想更加成熟，对战争规律的认识更加深刻，为后世留下了宝贵的军事遗产。
points.descriptionEn: Sun Tzu's military career in Wu reached its peak when he commanded the famous Battle of Boju, defeating the Chu army of 200,000 with only 30,000 troops and capturing the Chu capital Yingdu, creating a miracle in military history. However, with the death of King Helü and the succession of King Fuchai, the political environment changed, and Sun Tzu gradually withdrew from the political arena. He chose to retire and focus on military theory research, perfecting 'The Art of War'. During this period, Sun Tzu's military thought became more mature, and his understanding of the laws of war deepened, leaving a valuable military legacy for later generations.

points.title: 晚年与影响
points.description: 孙子晚年隐居，具体地点不详，可能在吴国或其故乡齐国。在这一时期，他继续完善自己的军事理论，并开始将军事思想应用于更广泛的领域。孙子的思想通过弟子和后人传承下来，逐渐形成了兵家学派。《孙子兵法》不仅在中国历史上产生了深远影响，也被翻译成多种语言，传播到世界各地，成为世界军事文化遗产的重要组成部分。孙子的军事思想超越了时代限制，对现代军事、商业管理、政治策略等领域仍有重要启示意义。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Sun Tzu lived in retirement, with the exact location unknown, possibly in the State of Wu or his homeland Qi. During this period, he continued to perfect his military theories and began to apply military thinking to broader fields. Sun Tzu's thoughts were passed down through his disciples and later generations, gradually forming the School of Military Strategy. 'The Art of War' not only had a profound impact in Chinese history but was also translated into many languages and spread around the world, becoming an important part of world military cultural heritage. Sun Tzu's military thought transcends time and still offers important insights into modern military, business management, political strategy, and other fields.

appraisal.zh: 孙子被尊为「兵圣」，《孙子兵法》既是军事经典，也被视为东方智慧的结晶，「知己知彼」「不战而屈人之兵」等思想影响远超军事领域。学界一般认为其思想具有超越时代的价值，但需结合具体历史背景理解。也有研究者指出，其学说偏重权谋诡道，对战争伦理关注不足，且所论多针对春秋时期的小规模战争，与当代高科技战争环境存在距离。
appraisal.en: Sun Tzu is revered as the "Sage of War," and The Art of War is regarded both as a military classic and as a crystallization of Eastern wisdom, with ideas such as "know yourself and know your enemy" and "subdue the enemy without fighting" reaching far beyond warfare. Historians generally hold that his thought retains value across eras, though it must be read against its historical context. Some researchers note, however, that his teaching leans heavily on stratagem and deception with little attention to the ethics of war, and that it addressed the small-scale warfare of the Spring and Autumn period, leaving a gap with modern high-tech conflict.

supporter.zh: 孙子被尊为'兵圣'，是中国古代最伟大的军事理论家。《孙子兵法》不仅是一部军事著作，更是一部哲学经典，体现了东方智慧的精髓。他提出的'知己知彼，百战不殆'、'不战而屈人之兵'等战略思想，超越了单纯的军事范畴，成为政治、商业、外交等领域的重要指导原则。孙子的军事思想强调智谋而非蛮力，重视战略而非战术，这种思想对后世产生了深远影响，被誉为'东方兵学的鼻祖'。
supporter.en: Sun Tzu is revered as the 'Sage of War', the greatest military theorist in ancient China. 'The Art of War' is not only a military work but also a philosophical classic, embodying the essence of Eastern wisdom. His strategic concepts such as 'know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated' and 'subdue the enemy without fighting' transcend purely military范畴 and become important guiding principles in politics, business, diplomacy, and other fields. Sun Tzu's military thought emphasizes wisdom over brute force and strategy over tactics, having a profound impact on later generations and earning him the title 'Father of Eastern Military Science'.

critic.zh: 批评者认为孙子的军事思想过于强调权谋和诡计，忽视了战争的道德维度。有人指出，《孙子兵法》中的某些策略如'兵者，诡道也'可能导致战争伦理的缺失。此外，孙子生活在春秋时期，其思想主要针对当时的小规模战争，与现代大规模、高科技战争环境存在较大差异。批评者还认为，孙子对将领个人素质的强调可能导致对集体智慧和现代军事组织结构的忽视，其理论在当代军事实践中的应用价值受到质疑。
critic.en: Critics argue that Sun Tzu's military thought overemphasizes strategy and deception, neglecting the moral dimension of war. Some point out that certain strategies in 'The Art of War', such as 'deception is the essence of war', may lead to a lack of war ethics. Furthermore, Sun Tzu lived during the Spring and Autumn Period, and his thoughts were mainly aimed at small-scale wars of that time, differing significantly from modern large-scale, high-tech warfare environments. Critics also believe that Sun Tzu's emphasis on individual qualities of generals may lead to neglect of collective wisdom and modern military organizational structures, and the value of his theory in contemporary military practice is questioned.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，孙子是中国古代军事思想的集大成者，其著作《孙子兵法》是中国军事文化的瑰宝。在流行文化中，孙子被塑造成智慧与谋略的象征，其思想被广泛应用于商业竞争、国际关系和个人发展等领域。历史学界普遍认为，孙子的军事思想具有超越时代的价值，但其理论也需要结合具体历史背景和现代条件进行理解。孙子的影响不仅限于军事领域，更体现在思维方式上，他强调的系统性思维、辩证方法和战略眼光，对现代管理科学和决策理论仍有重要启示。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Sun Tzu is the master of ancient Chinese military thought, and his work 'The Art of War' is a treasure of Chinese military culture. In popular culture, Sun Tzu is portrayed as a symbol of wisdom and strategy, and his thoughts are widely applied in business competition, international relations, and personal development. The historical community generally believes that Sun Tzu's military thought has value that transcends time, but his theory needs to be understood in conjunction with specific historical backgrounds and modern conditions. Sun Tzu's influence extends beyond the military field to ways of thinking; his emphasis on systematic thinking, dialectical methods, and strategic vision still offers important insights into modern management science and decision theory.

self.en: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated.
